meta.title: Sevier County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Sevier County's 2026 final budget as filed with the state. The amounts are the '2026 Budget' column of the county's budget report, printed December 10, 2025. Some funds move money to other county funds (transfers out, $1,900,537.00 in all); those dollars show up in both funds.
